title: EndroCity Client
description: Client Sided Collaboration Tool for Teammates, Sync Journey Maps, Ping Locations and Share Screenshots Effortlessly
body:
### Some Features of the Mod need JourneyMap Mod 

Teammates need the mod installed for it to work 
It doesn't need server side so it will work on any server

## Guide:
By default everyone with the mod is using the default team and pass  
If mod is on Server Side You can Use / commands otherwise Use the same command but starting with . instead of /  
Below I gave the .version of commands as it works on all servers

Use these commands to make pings,etc private for your team
```
.ec mqtt setteam yourteamname
.ec mqtt setpass password
```
Once team is set it also shows you teammates outside renderdistance on your JourneyMap

Replace urls with 2 different Discord Webhook Urls 
(A simple google search will guide you on getting Webhook Url for a Discord Channel)
```
.ec setpingurl url
.ec setmapurl url
```
Now everytime You Ping Screenshot will be sent to that channel
and the map channel will be used to sync Journey Maps of your Team


```
.ec syncmap push
.ec syncmap pull
```
push will upload your explored area of map to discord
pull will download others explored area of map from discord
(This lets Teammates have a Combined Explored Map)
For this to work teammates must use the same server name while saving the server or it won't work even tho it will upload and download
